passages.note: Author of SB 723 (prohibited-persons/outstanding-warrant firearm possession); addresses eligibility of already-prohibited persons, not the ladder's ownership-ban, weapon-type, background-check, or carry dimensions; also predates the current term (2022-12-05).

rows.reasoning: The only source is SB 723, which Jones authored, clarifying that firearm possession by a person with an outstanding felony or specified-misdemeanor warrant is a crime only when the person has knowledge of the warrant. This is a prohibited-persons eligibility rule, not a passage that speaks to civilian ownership bans, assault-style weapon bans, universal background checks, or carry-permit rules, so it is adjacent and cannot establish any rung. No passage survives V1-V5.
